commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 38 composition defined its five entry-incidence flags as equality against exemplar HTS lines from chapters 72, 76, 95, 22 and 85, conditions with no basis in chapter 38's cited provisions, so the §301/§232/§201/§338 and reciprocal-exclusion branches reading them could never fire for a chapter-38 entry.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 36 (byte-identical two-hunk diff apart from the chapter number, the generator's redundant-parenthesis depth, and the from/effective_from key spelling); I read the diff and confirmed no other formula, parameter, date, or citation change. Same kind reasoning and same alternative (wrong_entity_or_scope) as index 36.
triage.verifier_justification: The ch38 diff deletes five derived rules whose formulas were equality tests against single HTS lines of other chapters (e.g. entry_is_line_a = hts_number == "7202.11.10.00", a chapter-72 ferroalloy), each carrying proof atoms citing chapters 72/76/95/22/85 provisions, inside a chapter-38 composition; the branches consuming them (entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded, entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded, china_301_component_rate's five §301 slots, the §338 alcohol branch, the §232 aluminum-content branch) were therefore dead for every chapter-38 entry. Reading the cited source through the pinned release refutes the "it was correct, just narrow" defense: the reciprocal annex list under 9903.01.32 (us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-183) enumerates chapter-38 lines (3818.00.00, 3808.94.50, 3824.99.49, 3824.91.00) on the same page as 7202.11.10, so encoding "annex-excluded iff hts_number == 7202.11.10.00" for chapter 38 contradicts the provision it cites. The commit's own generator change states the rationale in fidelity terms — "generated compositions must not derive them from the five hand-built witness HTS exemplars" — and the module's boilerplate "runtime semantics are unchanged" does not hold, since the identifiers move from an always-false local derivation to caller-supplied incidence inputs. This is a condition with no basis in the cited source, grounded on the wrong provision, which the fix removes: untraceable_branch, not mechanical (formulas and proof atoms were deleted and the input surface changed) and not a mere scope enhancement.
triage.verifier_notes: Decisive corroboration outside the module diff: the same commit's tools/generate_schedule_compositions.py adds `selected.difference_update(ENTRY_FLAG_RULES)` under the comment "Referenced-but-undefined identifiers are composition inputs by repository convention.  Entry preparation now supplies the five witness-compatible incidence flags; generated compositions must not derive them from the five hand-built witness HTS exemplars." PR #1300 independently calls the exemplar coupling unlawful ("the witness's exemplar coupling, which round-2 evaluation showed unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins"), though that sentence describes section_122_component_rate, whose gating is NOT in this commit's ch38 diff. Caveats for the reviewer: (1) this is a generated file — the substantive edit lives in the generator, and the same 100-line removal repeats across ~100 sibling chapter modules in this commit, so the corpus should dedupe these to one defect instance (ch38 is one representative, module index 37); (2) the fix removes but does not re-ground — post-fix entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded is still `formula: entry_is_line_a`, now an opaque caller input, so the annex membership test is delegated to entry preparation rather than encoded; (3) witness-exemplar residue survives in ch38 (e.g. section_232_aluminum_component_rate is still sourced to "HTS 7601.10.30.00"), so this commit is a partial repair; (4) referencing formulas are token-identical pre/post — the meaning change comes entirely from the five definitions disappearing, which is why a diff-only skim could mistake it for mechanical. Alternative kind considered and rejected: wrong_entity_or_scope (the flags do scope to other chapters' product lines), but the task's own definition assigns "formulas grounded on the wrong provision" that the fix removes to untraceable_branch.
